stories.title: Our next steps for Alphabet stock after earnings disappoint at nearly every turn
stories.zh_title: 幾乎每次獲利都令人失望後，我們為Alphabet股票採取的下一步措施

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
stories.summary: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon's top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over […]
stories.zh_title: 谷歌推出Gemini 4 Carbon ，在網絡安全方面實現“重大飛躍”
stories.zh_summary: Google已發布其最新的前沿模型Gemini 4 Carbon ，在編碼、代理任務和網路安全方面提供「顯著收益」。在周三的公告中，谷歌突出了Carbon在人工智能指數（ v5.0 ）基準上的首要地位，其中包括Claude Opus 5.5和GPT-

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
stories.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is essentially a slightly better version of Argon.
stories.zh_title: Google宣佈推出Gemini 4 Carbon ，這是您無法使用的最新前沿AI模型
stories.zh_summary: Gemini 4 Carbon基本上是Argon的稍好版本。

stories.title: Why Alphabet’s stock could see its worst drop in years after the latest results
stories.summary: A doubling of cloud revenue wasn’t enough to appease Wall Street as investors grew more concerned that AI is hurting the company’s ability to make money off search queries.
stories.zh_title: 為什麼Alphabet的股價在最新業績後可能出現多年來最嚴重的下跌
stories.zh_summary: 隨著投資者越來越擔心人工智能正在損害該公司從搜索查詢中賺錢的能力，雲收入翻倍並不足以安撫華爾街。

stories.title: Fortinet’s stock is taking a dive after earnings. Here’s why.
stories.summary: Cybersecurity stocks are broadly falling as growth slows significantly in one of Fortinet’s business segments.
stories.zh_title: Fortinet的股票在盈利後下跌。原因如下。
stories.zh_summary: 由於Fortinet其中一個業務部門的增長顯著放緩，網絡安全股普遍下跌。

stories.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
stories.summary: Microsoft reported better-than-expected results driven by 48% growth in Azure revenue.
stories.zh_title: 隨著雲端增長推動盈利和收入增長，微軟股價上漲4%
stories.zh_summary: 在Azure營收增長48%的推動下， Microsoft報告的業績好於預期。

stories.title: Microsoft is ending Copilot support on smart TVs
stories.summary: Nearly two years after LG and Samsung announced at CES 2025 that their latest smart TVs would include access to Microsoft's Copilot, the company is ending support for the AI assistant's functionality on all TVs this year, according to a report by Windows Central. The news comes not from an official announcement from LG, Samsung, […]
stories.zh_title: Microsoft即將終止智慧電視上的Copilot支援
stories.zh_summary: 根據Windows Central的一份報告，在LG和三星在CES 2025上宣布他們最新的智能電視將包括訪問微軟的Copilot近兩年後，該公司今年將結束對所有電視上AI助手功能的支持。這個消息不是來自官方

stories.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
stories.summary: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
stories.zh_title: 隨著人工智慧客服人員重塑網路， Google將Gemini和Search開放給更多應用程式
stories.zh_summary: 新的開發人員平臺將允許企業將其服務帶入Google的AI體驗，從而可能改變消費者發現和使用應用程式的方式。

stories.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
stories.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
stories.zh_title: 時尚語音AI ： NVIDIA推出全新開放式轉譯模式
stories.zh_summary: Nvidia剛剛發布了一個可以轉錄多達40種語言的自由語音轉文字模型，但它只適用於錄音，而不適用於現場音頻，因此這是會議和醫療轉錄工具的一大步，同時仍然讓ElevenLabs等競爭對手實時使用。

stories.title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app
stories.summary: Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations. According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet." Users should talk, not type, with […]
stories.zh_title: Meta悄悄推出「AI寵物日記」應用程式
stories.zh_summary: Meta推出了名為Waddle World的「tamagotchi風格」寵物遊戲，虛擬生物可以與用戶聊天並創建塗鴉來說明對話。根據Apple和Play商店的列表，「16位元寵物護理遊戲」並不是真正的遊戲，而是「偽裝成寵物的日記」。

stories.title: The major reason Microsoft’s stock is heading higher after earnings
stories.summary: Microsoft showed investors that it’s able to grow rapidly while keeping spending in check.
stories.zh_title: 微軟股票在獲利後走高的主要原因
stories.zh_summary: 微軟向投資者展示，它能夠快速增長，同時控制支出。

stories.title: ServiceNow’s stock slides as earnings miss overshadows a raised AI outlook
stories.summary: Even with an uptick in multimillion-dollar AI deals, ServiceNow’s earnings results weren’t enough to win over software skeptics.
stories.zh_title: ServiceNow的股票下跌，因為盈利失誤掩蓋了提高的人工智能前景
stories.zh_summary: 即使數百萬美元的人工智能交易有所增加， ServiceNow的盈利結果也不足以贏得軟件懷疑論者的支持。

stories.title: Anthropic’s public benefit structure creates unusual risks for IPO investors
stories.summary: Anthropic’s PBC structure could put its AI mission ahead of shareholder returns
stories.zh_title: Anthropic的公益結構為IPO投資者帶來不尋常的風險
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic的PBC結構可能將其AI使命置於股東回報之前

stories.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
stories.summary: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic剛剛推出工具，向公司展示他們的人工智能支出
stories.zh_summary: 這家前沿實驗室正在為用戶在計劃的首次公開募股之前如何在模型上花錢拉開帷幕。
